sonnet.problem: This story card mostly restates what card 15 just answered (God says his life will be required of him this very night), and the only new piece is 'You fool!'. It moves the passage along very little. 'He planned for many years' also stretches verse 19. The text says he told himself he had plenty laid up for many years, not that he planned for many years.
The true/false statement joins two claims with 'and': that he has plenty laid up for many years, and that he should take it easy.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.
